NOT recorded and why - two calls the reporter should look at directly: (1) timber_beams left null. The page calls the building a "Brick & Timber Loft", which is the standard Chicago term for a timber-frame conversion, but it never says the timber is exposed. §4a's second hard signal ("exposed brick or exposed timber structure") is already satisfied by the stated exposed brick, so holding this costs no signal count. (2) former_industrial left null. "Brick & Timber Loft" implies a warehouse conversion and the stated year built is 1964, but the page never states a former industrial, warehouse or factory use. This is the signal that would decide hard-loft status, and I am not willing to infer it. §5 TRAP FLAG: the description says the unit "offers a lofted area currently used as a quaint guest bedroom". §4a explicitly says a sleeping loft or mezzanine in an otherwise conventional unit does not make a loft, and this must not be read as a duplex - layout left null. §5 CEILING FLAG: "soaring 12 ft." is very likely the highest point, not the typical height. parking_type left null: "gated parking space" does not say garage or lot; the $100/mo cost is stated and recorded. unit_level left null ("Floor 2" stated, page never says upper). heat_included recorded false from "Tenant pays utilities".
